meta.title: Seedance 2.0 vs Seedance 2.5: Should You Upgrade?
meta.description: Compare Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 by duration, resolution, references, editing, extension, live pricing, and the workflow each version fits best.

en.heroIntro: Seedance 2.0 and Seedance 2.5 both offer a 4K delivery path. Keep 2.0 for a validated 15-second setup. Choose 2.5 for scenes up to 30 seconds, native Draft → 1080p/4K finalization, more multimodal references, Modify and Extend.

quickVerdict.title: Quick verdict
quickVerdict.body: Choose Seedance 2.5 for longer scenes, a larger reference set and native Draft finalization in 1080p or 4K. Keep Seedance 2.0 when your established 15-second workflow already delivers the look you need. Compare the same inputs and current quotes; 4K alone no longer distinguishes these models.

topCards.title: Choose Seedance 2.0
topCards.body: Keep familiar 15-second prompt patterns and a delivery path you have already validated, including 4K.

topCards.title: Choose Seedance 2.5
topCards.body: Use the flagship route for clips up to 30 seconds, up to 50 combined references, optional generated audio, video editing, and extension.

topCards.title: Resolution and finalization
topCards.body: Both models offer 4K. Seedance 2.5 adds 30-second scenes and native Draft finalization in 1080p or 4K; both of those output tiers use 10-bit HEVC. Standard Modify retains 480p/720p limits.

items.question: Should I upgrade from Seedance 2.0 to Seedance 2.5?
items.answer: Choose Seedance 2.5 for longer scenes, a larger reference set and native Draft finalization in 1080p or 4K. Keep Seedance 2.0 when your established 15-second workflow already delivers the look you need. Compare the same inputs and current quotes; 4K alone no longer distinguishes these models.

items.question: Does Seedance 2.5 replace Seedance 2.0?
items.answer: No. Both model pages and generation routes remain available, including a 4K path. Seedance 2.5 adds longer scenes, a larger reference allowance and native Draft finalization; it does not replace your existing Seedance 2.0 route.

items.question: Which version supports longer video?
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 supports clips from 4 to 30 seconds. Seedance 2.0 supports clips up to 15 seconds, which remains useful for mature short-form workflows.

items.question: Which version is better for reference-heavy work?
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 is the stronger fit when the brief combines many image, video, and audio references. Seedance 2.0 supports reference-driven work too, but with a lower ceiling.

items.answer: Use the live pricing shown on this page and compare the same duration, mode, resolution, and audio choice. The displayed figures come from the current pricing projection rather than authored page copy.

items.question: Quelle version choisir pour beaucoup de références ?
